title: Bar Chart
content: Build bar chart component for categorical comparisons. Layout: vertical bars (default) or horizontal bars option. Bars: consistent width with gap between, colored fills, hover highlight. Labels: category names on X-axis, values on Y-axis with grid lines. Tooltip: show category and value on hover. Legend: for multi-series charts. Animation: bars grow from zero on initial load. Sorting: option to sort by value. Responsive: horizontal bars on mobile.

variants.simple: Create bar chart comparing values across categories.
variants.detailed: Build bar chart component for categorical comparisons. Layout: vertical bars (default) or horizontal bars option. Bars: consistent width with gap between, colored fills, hover highlight. Labels: category names on X-axis, values on Y-axis with grid lines. Tooltip: show category and value on hover. Legend: for multi-series charts. Animation: bars grow from zero on initial load. Sorting: option to sort by value. Responsive: horizontal bars on mobile.
variants.advanced: Build bar chart component for categorical comparisons with full interactivity. Layout: vertical bars (default) or horizontal bars option (better for long category names or mobile). Using Recharts BarChart or custom SVG. Bars: consistent width calculated based on data length with gap between (barGap={4}), colored fills (fill prop from palette), hover highlight (opacity increase or brightness), border-radius on tops (radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}). Labels: category names on X-axis (angle={-45} if many categories, textAnchor="end"), values on Y-axis with grid lines (cartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3"), proper axis formatting (currency, percentage, abbreviated numbers: 1K, 1M). Value labels: optional labels on top of bars showing exact values, show on hover or always visible. Grouped bars: multiple series side by side with different colors, grouped by category. Stacked bars: series stacked on top of each other (stackId="a"), showing composition and total. Tooltip: custom tooltip showing category name and all series values, color-coded. Legend: positioned below or right, color swatches + labels, click to toggle series. Animation: bars grow from zero with duration 500ms on initial load, update animations on data change. Sorting: dropdown to sort by value ascending/descending or alphabetically, animate bar position changes. Responsive: horizontal bars work better on mobile (swap axes), reduce bar count or enable horizontal scroll. Negative values: bars extending below zero line, different color for negative. Click handler: onClick per bar triggers drill-down or filter. Reference lines: show target or average line. Loading and empty states. Accessibility: data table fallback. Dark mode support.
